feature.label: CloudEmpiere Operational Observability Collector
feature.description: In-JVM OSGi observability collector for iDempiere. Surfaces bundle and DS-component lifecycle, 2Pack outcomes, boot phases and tenant context as structured stdout events. See ADR-001.
